value.note: Note: This guide is still a work in progress. We’ll keep updating it throughout the WoW Forever beta. If you spot anything missing, feel free to send it via the feedback button below.

sections.heading: WoW Forever Warrior Talent Calculator
paragraphs: The talent calculator below shows the three talent trees for the Warrior class in WoW Forever.
Use the left mouse button to invest talent points in Arms, Fury, and Protection. Use the right mouse button to remove talent points.

sections.heading: Warrior Builds in WoW Forever
paragraphs: Builds and specs for Warrior in WoW Forever are coming soon. Use our calculator to plan your WoW Forever talents today.

sections.heading: Warrior Changes in WoW Forever
items: Victory Rush: Warriors gain Victory Rush, giving them an additional attack after defeating an enemy and improving their ability to continue fighting while leveling and questing.
Shorter major cooldowns: The long cooldowns on major Warrior abilities such as Recklessness, Retaliation, and Shield Wall are reduced from 30 minutes to 15 minutes.
Improved Protection gameplay: Protection receives several talent changes intended to make deep Protection builds more competitive, including additional offensive options further down the talent tree.
Less stance switching for Protection: Protection Warriors can gain access to abilities such as Charge and Thunder Clap while in Defensive Stance, reducing the need to switch stances.

More damage options for tanks: The reworked Protection tree includes stronger damage-oriented talents alongside its defensive and threat talents, giving tank-focused Warriors more ways to improve their damage without relying as heavily on Fury/Protection hybrid builds.
Skyborne Warriors: The new Skyborne race can play Warrior on both the Alliance and Horde, adding a new playable race option for the class. Learn here how to unlock the Skyborne race in WoW Forever.
paragraphs: Warriors receive several changes in WoW Forever, including reworked talent trees, a new ability, shorter major cooldowns, and improvements to Protection gameplay. Arms, Fury, and Protection retain the stance-based, Rage-driven gameplay of Vanilla WoW, but several changes are designed to make the class less restrictive and give deep Protection builds more options. Blizzard has confirmed that Forever classes will receive new abilities and talent updates, while many of the Warrior-specific details below come from the playable BlizzCon 2026 demo and may still change before release.

Warriors often take on the role of tank and also achieve the highest damage in the game as a DPS class against many raid bosses. Learn more about Warrior talents and changes in our WoW Forever Warrior overview.

class.description:

level.description:
